_comment: Per solve-file: which moves the ACTUAL code exercised, with a verdict. Verdicts: clean (executed correctly unaided), struggled (needed correction/hints), avoided (solved the problem via an alternative walk, so this move went undrilled - record it on the move that the canonical walk teaches). Keyed by filename like data/summaries.json; utils/kg/kg_extract appends, never rewrites. Mastery is derived from this file at query time: clean within ~6 weeks = SOLID; older = STALE; only-once-or-struggled = FRAGILE; absent = MISSING. seconds = active seconds on the clock when make solved ran (kg_solved), filed with the placeholder and kept through every rewrite; absent on records from before the timer.
